immutable_failure_reproduction.observed_failure: active paper snapshot is outside 24h for 2330.TW: event_time=2026-08-28T05:30:00Z age_seconds>86400
immutable_failure_reproduction.root_cause: A fixed 24h max-age check compared now (Saturday) against the latest official Friday TWSE/TPEx close, which cannot have a newer official close until the next trading session, so the deploy readback gate and Agora operational readiness both fail-closed on a market condition (weekend) rather than a real staleness or lineage defect.

diagnosis.cause: market_snapshot_admission.admit_market_snapshot, the deploy script's inline readback check, and services/control-plane/bff/agora/operational_readiness.py each compared age_seconds against a flat max_age_seconds/sla_seconds with no notion of Asia/Taipei trading sessions, weekends, or official market holidays.
constraints_preserved: Non-Taiwan symbols keep the unchanged flat max_age_seconds behavior in admit_market_snapshot and operational_readiness.

Weekday staleness (an explicit newer validated session closed), a stale refresh receipt, missing/unverifiable calendar evidence, non-official lineage, and future event/observation/fetched times remain fail-closed with typed reason codes.
No new provider egress, fixture data, or bypass of the minimum-closes / lineage checks.

shared_rule.rule: A Taiwan official close is admitted when the gap between its event_time and now is fully explained by weekends (deterministic, requiring no feed) and/or validated official exchange calendar evidence (citing TWSE/TPEx HTTPS source URL, authority, 64-hex SHA-256 matching external trusted pin, exact Asia/Taipei timezone, strict ISO dates, and non-future fetched time), and the refresh receipt (observed_at) is within max_refresh_age_seconds of now, and the lineage carries an official tw-official:/tw-twse-tpex-official-market marker. Any completed weekday in the gap requires an explicit validated session record; missing or unverifiable evidence returns market_input_calendar_unverifiable, and market_input_stale is returned only for an explicit validated trading session.

call_sites.change: none required; it already calls the shared admit_market_snapshot, which now internally routes Taiwan symbols through evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness.
none required; _check_market_admission already delegates to the shared admit_market_snapshot.

_evaluate_source now imports evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness/is_taiwan_symbol/parse_rfc3339 from market_snapshot_admission and routes Taiwan-symbol snapshots through the same rule (extracting calendar_evidence when present) instead of the flat age_seconds > sla_seconds comparison; non-Taiwan snapshots are unchanged.

verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback's inline Python readback check imports evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness/is_taiwan_symbol and replaces the flat 'outside 24h' SystemExit for Taiwan symbols with the shared rule (extracting calendar_evidence when present); the future-time (-300s) guard and the official-lineage check are unchanged.

Calendar evidence with incomplete range rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable.
Completed weekday without calendar evidence rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable (Defect 2).
Completed weekday with explicit validated trading session rejected as market_input_stale (Defect 2).
holiday_lookup returning authority-only record without full contract validation rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable (Defect 3).
Calendar evidence with TAIFEX, TW, or non-cash venue rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable (Defect 4).
Calendar evidence with UTC, UTC+8, or timezone alias rejected; exact Asia/Taipei required (Defect 4).
Calendar evidence with HTTP scheme rejected; HTTPS required (Defect 5).
Calendar evidence with invalid or non-64-hex checksum rejected (Defect 5).
Calendar evidence with self-asserted checksum not in trusted external pin rejected (Defect 5).
Calendar evidence with future fetched_at timestamp (>300s) rejected (Defect 6).
Calendar evidence with non-ISO coverage_start, coverage_end, holiday, session, or trading date rejected (Defect 6).
Calendar evidence with unofficial URL domain rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable.
Stale refresh receipt (observed_at older than max_refresh_age_seconds) rejected as market_input_stale_refresh.
Future event_time rejected as market_input_invalid.
Non-official lineage rejected as market_input_non_official_lineage.
Unverifiable calendar evidence (lookup sentinel) rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable.
